summary: Backend integration tests for Sparsa Homeoclinic — 33/33 passed. Covered auth (all 6 seeded users, cookie + Bearer + logout), RBAC (Hemanth scoped, Jyothi all-access, Admin all-access, reception/pharmacy blocked from admin endpoints), full reception→doctor→pharmacy→PRO workflow including prescription versioning (v1 by doctor, v2 by pharmacy w/ edited_by_pharmacy flag), auto status transitions, partial→full payment with stable receipt_no, reminders filtered by doctor, AI assist (summarize/advice/instructions) via Claude Sonnet 4.5 through Emergent LLM key, and admin endpoints (users CRUD, audit logs, stats).

minor.issue: Cookie set with samesite=none + secure=true. Works for cross-site frontend but means cookie won't be sent over HTTP. OK for prod but worth noting.
allow_origin_regex='.*' combined with allow_credentials=True is permissive (Starlette echoes the origin). Acceptable for internal app, but consider restricting to known origins in production.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~840 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into routers (auth, patients, cases, pharmacy, payments, ai, admin) and a separate seed.py for maintainability.
JWT_SECRET is committed in /app/backend/.env. Acceptable in dev; ensure rotated for production.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook called out 5-fail lockout). Not implemented — recommend adding if exposed beyond internal LAN.
set_auth_cookie uses secure=True + samesite='none' only; if the app is ever served over HTTP, cookie auth will silently break. Cookie auth currently works because frontend is HTTPS.
AI endpoint imports emergentintegrations inside the handler on every call — fine functionally but adds ~100ms overhead; move to module-level import.
PaymentIn allows medicine_amount > 0 even when medicines_taken=False (server zeroes it), but no validation feedback to caller. Acceptable but consider Pydantic validator.

/api/admin/stats grants OWNER_DOCTOR access (require_roles(ADMIN, OWNER_DOCTOR)) which contradicts user statement that admin should have 'complete access to … stats' implying exclusive — verify with product owner; not a bug, just an intent check.
test_credentials: admin1/jyothi/hemanth/reception1/pharmacy1/pro1 all with Password@123 — all verified working via /api/auth/login.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed patients + cases per run (not cleaned up). Counters (patient_uid, case_uid, receipt_no) increment across runs as expected. Also creates one disposable RECEPTION user per run via /api/admin/users (test_admin_create_user).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid. Use /app/backend/tests/test_sparsa_backend.py as regression. Tests use Bearer token (from login response) — both cookie and Bearer auth paths verified. AI tests hit real Claude Sonnet 4.5 (each call ~3-5s, total AI suite ~12s). If running frontend tests next, focus on (a) login form sets cookie & redirects by role, (b) reception → create patient → create case flow, (c) doctor dashboard scopes for hemanth vs jyothi, (d) AI assist buttons render result, (e) PRO billing print receipt EN+Telugu.
